title: CR-PAY-009 — Invoice + AP/AR viewer
preconds:
Permissions (counted): 

  1. WO: View
  2. Part Sales: View,
  3. Customers: View,
  4. Invoicing: View,
  5. Vendor Order & Management: View,
  6. See AP/AR: ON.

 Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: View invoices + Finance tab (WO and Part Sale); AP/AR Payments/Credits/Unpaid Invoices tabs (Customer and Vendor); aging; bulk payments from Unpaid Invoices tab

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks. See Flag / Note.
Spec Ref: §1h+§5b
Flag / Note: \u26a0 bulk-payment execution may also need Invoicing E (§5b vs §1h)
